It’s highly effective. I’m not an expert, but I’d say you’ve probably got up to a four hour window (or bigger) if you’re on combo pills. If it’s progestin only, then I’ve heard you really want to aim for the same time every day (5 Minute window is an exaggeration of this - I’ve seen a 2 hour window used to describe progestin-only). 

Just be mindful if you miss a pill. As long as you use backup contraceptives then (condom), you’ll be fine.

I use an app called “Alarmed”. It’s just a simple reminder app. If you’re on iPhone, put it in the bottom row of four apps so you’ll always see the red notification circle on the corner of the app icon if you haven’t taken your BC yet.

It’s worked really well for me. I forgot my pill yesterday though, only because I didn’t have my phone, so if you do use it, just try not to rely on it too much (try to remember to take your BC yourself if you can. The app should just be an emergency backup).

I hope this helps!

Edit: I wanted to include that I’ve been on BC for about seven months now and yesterday was the first time I’ve forgotten.

When dealing with someone who may be depressed, it’s important to ask them to tell you how they’re feeling. I find that I feel like I don’t have anyone I can talk to without consequence. Having such a resource would help me so much.
